question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"generate good returns on" **is commonly** followed by** the word **"investment" **because i**t implies that the benefits gained are a result of the resources (money, time, effort) put into organic agriculture.**
 
• The options **"loss", "expenditure", and "profit" **do not fit as appropriately in the context of returns on resources allocated.
 
• Using **"investment" **helps maintain clarity and accurately reflects the idea of gaining benefits from the resources used in organic agriculture.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2 (investment)**.

 

***Correct Sentence:*** *"Organic agriculture offers a means to substitute costlier agricultural inputs such as HYV seeds, chemical fertilisers and pesticides with locally produced organic inputs that are cheaper and thereby generate good returns on **investment**.*"
